Subject: Invitation to Speak at the Future of Tech Conference

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of the organizing committee for the upcoming Future of Tech Conference, scheduled to take place on [Date] in [Location]. This year’s theme is "Innovation in the Age of AI," focusing on the ethical implications and transformative potential of artificial intelligence across various industries.

Given your extensive work and thought leadership in [Speaker's Specific Field/Topic], we believe you would be an exceptional fit for our keynote slot. Your recent insights on [Specific Topic or Recent Work] align perfectly with our audience's interests and the core message we wish to convey.

We would be honored to have you join us as a keynote speaker. The engagement includes a 45-minute presentation followed by a 15-minute Q&A session. In recognition of your time and expertise, we are offering a speaking fee of [Amount]. We will also cover all travel and accommodation expenses for your stay.

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to schedule a brief call to discuss the details further.

Thank you for considering our invitation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Organization]
[Contact Information]
